@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+# Feed format
+
+Each station uploads one line per reading, comma separated:
+
+| Column | Unit | Example |
+|---|---|---|
+| Station ID | — | `harbor-point` |
+| Time | ISO 8601, UTC | `2026-07-21T08:00:00Z` |
+| Temperature | °C | `14.2` |
+| Humidity | % | `78` (empty while the sensor warms up) |
+| Pressure | hPa | `1012.6` |
+| Wind speed | m/s | `5.4` |
+| Wind direction | degrees | `230` |
+| Rainfall | mm in the last hour | `0.4` (optional) |
